hook_text: These golden cliffs were once loose sand blowing across a desert. So how did they become rock?
clip_script: Golden Gate, Free State. Cliffs striped like the pages of a book. Step one: rock breaks into sediment. Step two: wind and water carry it away. Step three: it settles in flat layers, bottom first. Step four: the weight of new layers squashes it. Step five: minerals glue the grains together. Wait millions of years. Sand becomes sandstone!
visual_style: Whiteboard cliff with numbered steps, sand grains falling in layers, a heavy weight pressing down and glue dots between grains.
mood: Epic and golden, like a story told over millions of years.
pacing: Five clear steps, each with one quick image.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and make your own sedimentary sandwich.
